subtitle.en: Final year: projects, jobs and graduation
subtitle.zu: Unyaka wokugcina: amaphrojekthi, imisebenzi nokuthweswa iziqu

blurb.en: Final-year pressure, applications, old debts and the walk across the stage. About 6 minutes.
blurb.zu: Ingcindezi yonyaka wokugcina, izicelo, izikweletu ezindala nokuhamba esiteji. Cishe imizuzu emi-6.

text.en: Your final-year project counts for a big part of your degree, and the deadline is twelve weeks away.
text.zu: Iphrojekthi yakho yonyaka wokugcina ibalwa njengengxenye enkulu yeziqu zakho, futhi umnqamulajuqu usemasontweni ayishumi nambili.

outcome.en: Twelve weeks feels like forever. Until it's six.
outcome.zu: Amasonto ayishumi nambili azwakala engapheli. Aze abe yisithupha.

label.en: Plan milestones, join a writing workshop

outcome.en: The writing centre's research workshop helps you set a chapter every two weeks. It already feels smaller.
outcome.zu: Isifundisane socwaningo sesikhungo sokubhala sikusiza ubeke isahluko njalo emasontweni amabili. Sekuzwakala kuncane.

outcome.en: Your supervisor narrows your topic in twenty minutes. Clarity is a gift.
outcome.zu: Umphathi wakho unciphisa isihloko sakho emizuzwini engamashumi amabili. Ukucaca kuyisipho.

text.en: Six applications sent, four rejections back. Your classmates keep posting offers.
text.zu: Izicelo eziyisithupha zithunyelwe, ezine zenqatshiwe. Abafunda nawe balokhu bethumela izithombe zemisebenzi abayitholile.

outcome.en: It stops the sting, and also the chances.
outcome.zu: Kuyaqeda ubuhlungu, kanye namathuba.

outcome.en: Career services rework your CV. The next two applications get interviews.
outcome.zu: Izinsizakalo zemisebenzi zilungisa kabusha i-CV yakho. Izicelo ezimbili ezilandelayo zithola izingxoxo zokuqashwa.

tip.en: University career fairs bring employers to campus, usually once or twice a year. Career services publish the dates and will check your CV beforehand.
tip.zu: Imibukiso yemisebenzi yenyuvesi iletha abaqashi ekhampasi, ngokuvamile kanye noma kabili ngonyaka. Izinsizakalo zemisebenzi zishicilela izinsuku futhi zizohlola i-CV yakho ngaphambili.

outcome.en: Smaller companies, public sector and internships. More doors than you thought.
outcome.zu: Izinkampani ezincane, umkhakha kahulumeni nezinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa. Iminyango eminingi kunalokho obukucabanga.

tip.en: Go to the university career fair with printed CVs, and check the career services portal and your department's notice board for graduate programmes and internships.
tip.zu: Yiya embukisweni wemisebenzi wenyuvesi nama-CV aphrintiwe, futhi uhlole iphothali yezinsizakalo zemisebenzi nebhodi lezaziso lomnyango wakho ukuthola izinhlelo zabaphothule nama-internship.

text.en: Your closest friends have finished or moved for work, and loneliness comes back. {memory}
text.zu: Abangane bakho abasondelene nawe sebeqedile noma bathuthela emsebenzini, futhi isizungu siyabuya. {memory}

events.research: DHET cohort data: few graduate in minimum time

outcome.en: You stop going to campus unless you have to.
outcome.zu: Uyayeka ukuya ekhampasi ngaphandle uma kudingeka.

outcome.en: You go to their graduation and cheer the loudest. Their win doesn't make you less.
outcome.zu: Uya ekuthweswenikwabo iziqu futhi umemeze kakhulu. Ukunqoba kwabo akukwenzi ube mncane.

outcome.en: You join a final-year study circle. Everyone there is also figuring it out.
outcome.zu: Ujoyina iqembu lokufunda lonyaka wokugcina. Wonke umuntu lapho naye usazama ukukuthola.

title.en: Your certificate is held back until fees are paid
title.zu: Isitifiketi sakho sibanjiwe kuze kukhokhwe imali

text.en: The debt from earlier years caught up with you: the university says your certificate stays with them until your balance is settled.
text.zu: Isikweletu seminyaka edlule sikufinyelele: inyuvesi ithi isitifiketi sakho sihlala kubo kuze kukhokhwe ibhalansi yakho.

outcome.en: Without the certificate, job applications stall.
outcome.zu: Ngaphandle kwesitifiketi, izicelo zemisebenzi ziyama.

outcome.en: A monthly plan you can afford, and a letter confirming your degree for employers in the meantime.
outcome.zu: Uhlelo lwanyanga zonke ongalukhokha, nencwadi eqinisekisa iziqu zakho kubaqashi okwamanje.

outcome.en: The fees office points you to a programme that helps clear historic student debt. You apply that week.
outcome.zu: Ihhovisi lezimali likukhombisa uhlelo olusiza ukususa izikweletu ezindala zabafundi. Ufaka isicelo ngalelo sonto.

title.en: Funding is running out because you've taken longer
title.zu: Uxhaso luyaphela ngoba uthathe isikhathi eside

text.en: The repeated module means an extra semester, and your funding only covers the minimum time plus a little.
text.zu: Isifundo esiphindiwe sisho isemesta eyengeziwe, futhi uxhaso lwakho lukhava kuphela isikhathi esincane kanye nokuncane.

outcome.en: You stop one semester short. It's not the end of options, but it's a hard place to restart from.
outcome.zu: Uyeka kusasele isemesta eyodwa. Akusikho ukuphela kwezindlela, kodwa kuyindawo enzima yokuqala kabusha.

outcome.en: Slower, but you finish.
outcome.zu: Kuyahamba kancane, kodwa uyaqeda.

tip.en: Ask your faculty office how to change to part-time registration, and ask your funder what it does to your funding.
tip.zu: Buza ehhovisi lefakhalthi yakho ukuthi ushintshela kanjani ekubhaliseni kwesikhashana, futhi ubuze umxhasi wakho ukuthi kwenzani oxhasweni lwakho.

outcome.en: The financial aid office helps you apply for a final-semester bursary.
outcome.zu: Ihhovisi losizo lwezimali likusiza ufake isicelo somxhaso wesemesta yokugcina.

text.en: You're about to graduate, and you're not sure what you can actually do at work.
text.zu: Usuzothweswa iziqu, futhi awuqiniseki ukuthi yini ongayenza ngempela emsebenzini.

events.research: Understanding Students: many feel work skills underdeveloped

outcome.en: Maybe it will be fine. You don't check.
outcome.zu: Mhlawumbe kuzolunga. Awuhloli.

outcome.en: A free online course and a small project to show employers.
outcome.zu: Isifundo samahhala ku-inthanethi nephrojekthi encane yokukhombisa abaqashi.

tip.en: Your library login often gives free access to online courses. Career services can tell you which skills employers in your field ask for.
tip.zu: Ukungena kwakho emtapweni kuvame ukunikeza ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezifundweni ze-inthanethi. Izinsizakalo zemisebenzi zingakutshela ukuthi yimaphi amakhono afunwa abaqashi emkhakheni wakho.

outcome.en: A mock interview shows you can explain your degree better than you thought.
outcome.zu: Ingxoxo yokuzilolonga ikukhombisa ukuthi ungachaza iziqu zakho kangcono kunalokho obukucabanga.

title.en: A job offer far from home

text.en: You're offered a job in another province. At home, everyone assumed you'd come back and help.
text.zu: Unikezwa umsebenzi kwesinye isifundazwe. Ekhaya, wonke umuntu ubecabanga ukuthi uzobuya uzosiza.

outcome.en: Home is grateful. You keep looking for work closer by.
outcome.zu: Ekhaya bayabonga. Uqhubeka ufuna umsebenzi eduze.

outcome.en: A hard conversation, then a plan: you'll send money monthly and visit in December.
outcome.zu: Ingxoxo enzima, bese kuba nohlelo: uzothumela imali nyanga zonke futhi uvakashele ngoDisemba.

outcome.en: The employer agrees to a later start date, so you can help settle things at home first.
outcome.zu: Umqashi uyavuma usuku lokuqala lwakamuva, ukuze ukwazi ukusiza ukuhlela izinto ekhaya kuqala.

text.en: Gown hire, photos and travel for your family add up to about R1 500. You have {money}.
text.zu: Ukuqasha ingubo, izithombe nokugibela komndeni wakho kufika cishe ku-R1 500. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: You save the money. Your family is quietly disappointed.
outcome.zu: Uyayonga imali. Umndeni wakho udumazekile buthule.

outcome.en: You saved a little each month. Everyone is there.
outcome.zu: Ubonga kancane nyanga zonke. Wonke umuntu ukhona.

outcome.en: You borrow a gown from a graduate and share transport with another family. R500 instead of R1 500.
outcome.zu: Uboleka ingubo kumuntu osethweswe iziqu futhi nabelane ngokugibela nomunye umndeni. U-R500 esikhundleni sika-R1 500.

text.en: Your name is read out. Somewhere in the hall, someone from home is ululating. You made it.
text.zu: Igama lakho liyafundwa. Endaweni ethile ehholo, othile wasekhaya uyakikiza. Ukwenzile.

text.en: Do you know exactly which modules and credits you still need to graduate?
text.zu: Uyazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izifundo namakhredithi osawadinga ukuze uphothule?

outcome.en: Your faculty office checks your record against the degree rules. One missing module now is a fix; in December it is another year.
outcome.zu: Ihhovisi lefakhalthi yakho lihlola irekhodi lakho ngokwemithetho yeziqu. Isifundo esisodwa esishodayo manje siyalungiseka; ngoDisemba kungomunye unyaka.

outcome.en: You probably are. If you want to be sure, the faculty office can confirm it in a few minutes.
outcome.zu: Cishe ulungile. Uma ufuna ukuqiniseka, ihhovisi lefakhalthi lingakuqinisekisa ngemizuzu embalwa.
